runs.text: The Golan Heights: one hundred years in sixty seconds. nineteen twenty three. Britain and France draw a line. The Golan goes to Syria. nineteen forty nine. The armistice leaves Syria on the heights, above the Sea of Galilee. Both sides clash, and Syrian guns shell the farms below. nineteen sixty five. Syria starts diverting the Jordan's sources. Israel strikes the works. June nineteen sixty seven. In two days, Israel takes the Golan. nineteen seventy three. On Yom Kippur, Syria attacks. Israel holds, then pushes back. nineteen seventy four. A Kissinger deal returns Quneitra to Syria. United Nations peacekeepers move in. nineteen eighty one. Israel applies its law there. The UN Security Council: null and void. two thousand. Talks with Syria collapse over the Sea of Galilee shore. twenty nineteen. America recognises Israeli sovereignty. Most of the world does not. December twenty twenty four. Assad falls, and Israeli troops enter the buffer zone. Syria says occupied land. Israel says security frontier. Who's right? It all began with one line, drawn in nineteen twenty three.
